actions.script:
recordFound = !!headerOut.visible const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const enc = (text) => String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"') printUrl = '/apps/Projects/Projects/StatusReport?renderMode=html-print&workEffortId=' + encodeURIComponent(workEffortId) if (!recordFound) { printHtml = '

' + enc(L('This project is not available')) + '

'; return } const header = headerOut.header const overview = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectOverview').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId}).call()?.overview || {} const row = (label, value) => value ? '' + enc(L(label)) + '' + value + '' : '' const lines = (text) => enc(text).replace(/\n/g, '
') const table = (heads, rows) => rows.length ? '' + heads.map((head) => '').join('') + '' + rows.map((cells) => '' + cells.map((cell) => '').join('') + '').join('') + '
' + enc(L(head)) + '
' + enc(cell) + '
' : '

' + enc(L('None')) + '

' const latest = Array.from(overview.updateList || [])[0] const budget = overview.timeBudget printHtml = '
' + enc(header.workEffortName) + ' (' + enc(workEffortId) + ')
' + '

' + enc([L('Status report'), ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'MMMM d, yyyy')].join(' · ')) + '

' + '' + row('Status', enc(header.statusLabel)) + row('Health', enc(header.healthLabel ? header.healthLabel + (header.healthDateText ? ' (' + header.healthDateText + ')' : '') : L('Not set'))) + row('Client', enc(header.clientName)) + row('Manager', enc(header.managerName)) + row('Target date', enc(header.dueText)) + row('Work items', enc(header.progressText + ' · ' + header.openItems + ' ' + L('open') + (header.overdueItems ? ', ' + header.overdueItems + ' ' + L('overdue') : ''))) + row('Hours', enc(header.hoursText)) + '
' + '
' + enc(L('Latest update')) + '
' + (latest ? '

' + enc(latest.subject) + '
' + enc([latest.dateText, latest.authorName, latest.percentText].filter((part) => part).join(' · ')) + '

' + lines(latest.body) + '

' : '

' + enc(L('No status update yet')) + '

') + '
' + enc(L('Next milestones and releases')) + '
' + table(['Name', 'Type', 'Due', 'Status', 'Done'], Array.from(overview.milestoneList || []).map((ms) => [ms.workEffortName, ms.typeLabel, ms.dueText, ms.statusLabel, ms.progressText])) + '
' + enc(L('Work items by status')) + '
' + table(['Status', 'Items'], Array.from(overview.statusCountList || []).map((st) => [st.label, String(st.count)])) + '
' + enc(L('Breakdown')) + '
' + table(['Item', 'Status', 'Estimate', 'Actual + remaining', 'Done'], Array.from(overview.topItemList || []).map((it) => [it.workEffortId + ' ' + it.workEffortName, it.statusLabel, it.estimateText, it.usedText, it.doneText])) + (budget ? '
' + enc(L('Time and budget')) + '
' + row('Estimated', enc(budget.estimatedText)) + row('Actual', enc(budget.actualText)) + row('Remaining', enc(budget.remainingText)) + row('Hours budget', enc(budget.budgetText)) + row('Client budget', enc(budget.clientBudgetText ? budget.clientBudgetText + (budget.clientUsedText ? ' · ' + budget.clientUsedText + ' ' + L('used') : '') : '')) + row('Note', enc(budget.flagText)) + '
' : '')

render-mode.text: ${JSON.stringify({t: "link", id: "StatusReportPrint", text: ec.l10n.localize("Open the printable status report"), url: printUrl})}
